senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; denom. of אוֹר)look, appearance, countenance; attribute.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100a:12">Snh. 100ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>לת̇ר̇ופ̇ה̇</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 47:12">Ez. XLVII, 12</cite>) <he>לת̇ואר̇ פנים של בעלי הפ̇ה̇</he> for brightening the countenance of the speakers.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite> <he>ראו</he> … <he>תָּאֳרוֹ</he> … <he>מלאך וכ׳</he> Moses’ parents saw that he looked like an angel of God.—<he>יפת ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00500"><he>יָפֶה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:19">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="H00121"><he>חֲבֵרוּת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:1:7">Y. Sabb. VI, 7ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בשיש עליהן ת׳ כלי</he> when they bear the attribute of (are classified among) vessels; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:12:4">Y. Bets. I, end, 61ᵃ</cite>; (Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:7:2">Y. Sabb. VIII, end, 11ᶜ</cite> <he>אין עליו ת׳ כלי</he> it does not pass by the name of a vessel; a. e.—Pl. <he>תָּאֳרִים</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10:1">Cant. R. to I, 10</cite> (play on <he>בתורים</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10:1">ib.</cite>) <he>בשני ת׳ … שתּוֹאֲרָן טובה</he> (!)<he>וכ׳</he> with two countenances, with two brothers, Moses and Aaron, who looked at each other in friendliness, each rejoicing in the other’s greatness.
